repair.checkpoint: <logstem>-monitor.json, atomic replacement after flushed/fsynced content; every output scan and before each stop signal
repair.measurements: Observed elapsed time, sampled direct-child peak RSS, sample count, output bytes, all failure reasons, signal/wait errors, and actually reaped exit code
repair.cleanup: SIGTERM and at most 5s wait, then SIGKILL and at most 2s wait; denied group signals fall back only to the directly owned child
repair.uncertain_cleanup: Null exit_code, cleanup_incomplete, manual_stop_required=true; never report successful completion when owned-child exit is unverified
repair.unchanged_limits: The caller's 2048 MiB memory, wall-time, output and 16 MiB log limits remain enforced; recorded breaches survive a later zero exit code
repair.measurement_limitations: Quarter-second sampling is not an instantaneous maximum; descendant RSS and descendant exit are not independently verified. A denied signal is recorded, not treated as successful termination.
